name: turn-stats
description: Report generation speed, token counts, prompt-cache hit rate, tool time and estimated cost after each Codex turn.

interface.shortDescription: Per-turn speed, cache hit rate, tool time and cost
interface.longDescription: Adds a one-line summary after every agent turn: generation speed in tokens per second, output token count, share of reasoning tokens, prompt-cache hit rate, tool call count and time, and the estimated API cost in USD. Every segment can be switched off individually.
